description: Grant specific people access to a file or folder in a SharePoint document library by email address. Defaults to read-only access and does NOT send a notification email unless sendInvitation is true. Requires a write permission (e.g. Sites.ReadWrite.All) — an admin may need to approve it.

message.description: Optional message included in the notification email (only sent when sendInvitation is true)

recipients.description: Email addresses to grant access to (e.g., ["jane@example.com"])

sendInvitation.description: Send a sharing notification email to recipients (default: false)

name: invite_item_collaborators
